improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating what Gideon offers and the free trial hook. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. The copy emphasizes key value props (instant answers, voice chat, trade support) and the low-friction entry point (three free searches) without inventing claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for professionals. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and clarifies its purpose (AI assistant for trade and business), building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while emphasizing the low-commitment free trial. 'No card required' removes friction and builds trust, encouraging visitors to engage before the paywall.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a GDN AI member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, and you can choose monthly or annual billing—annual members save 30 percent. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own dedicated workspace.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point for trial users—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free to paid, stating the entry price, and highlighting the annual discount and member benefits, it reduces uncertainty and encourages conversion.
